reuse.why: Adds a shared hasSavedTemplates predicate, but setZero gets a fresh copy of the hidden/group-hidden SQL already repeated in the three average actions rather than a shared category selection, and the predicate parses goal_def itself where goal-template.ts treats non-null goal_def as having templates.

duplication.why: The hidden-category SQL now exists in four action queries plus copyPreviousMonth's row check, and the template check is a separate if-continue pasted into five loops.

placement.why: Everything stays in budget/actions.ts next to the actions it governs, consistent with the tree.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and getBudgetData are touched.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule set is spread across five functions (SQL in four, row checks in one, plus five template guards), so the next exclusion must be added five times.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared month-wide category selection to bypass; each action already had its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden rule is stated as SQL in setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and as `hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1` row checks in copyPreviousMonth, the same exclusion in two shapes.

one_place.where: The template exclusion is one predicate called separately at five sites, while the hidden exclusion is restated in each action's query (setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg) and in copyPreviousMonth.
